note: Free/limited LLM endpoint + repo CLASS codes (single source of truth). The intelligence engine branches on these NUMERIC codes, never on display strings. Codes >= quarantine_floor are quarantine (rejected). Shared with both the endpoint registry and the gateway-repo watchlist.

classes.label: official_free_limited_provider
classes.desc: An official provider with a documented free/limited tier (e.g. GitHub Models, Groq). Candidate prototype resource, NOT production infrastructure.

classes.label: official_trial_credit_provider
classes.desc: Official provider whose 'free' is time/credit-limited trial credit (not a durable free tier).

classes.label: official_paid_required_provider
classes.desc: Official provider that requires payment/credit purchase; NOT free by default (e.g. Together AI). Do not list as free.

classes.label: inference_aggregator
classes.desc: An official aggregator offering many providers behind one endpoint, including free variants (e.g. OpenRouter free models, Hugging Face Inference Providers). Intermediary risk: verify routing + data handling.

classes.label: self_hosted_gateway
classes.desc: A self-hostable OpenAI-compatible proxy/gateway repo aggregating official free tiers. LAB CANDIDATE only: useful pattern, NOT trusted infrastructure; self-host with dev-only keys after security review.

classes.label: discovery_list
classes.desc: An awesome-list / catalog of free LLM APIs. METADATA ONLY: feeds discovery; every row must be reverified against official provider docs before activation.

classes.label: browser_agent_runtime
classes.desc: A browser/WebContainer agent runtime (e.g. ClawLess). NOT an LLM endpoint. A Teleon Sandbox/runtime candidate; never an inference provider; no production keys/data until secret-handling review.

classes.label: shared_key_repo_quarantine
classes.desc: Repo distributing shared/free/leaked provider keys, or marketing 'unlimited'/'bypass'. QUARANTINE: never an approved provider.

classes.label: reverse_engineered_quarantine
classes.desc: Reverse-engineered/unofficial access to a chatbot or provider. QUARANTINE.

classes.label: unknown_quarantine
classes.desc: Claims a free endpoint but lacks official docs / has unclear data retention. QUARANTINE until officially documented; cannot reach candidate.

promotion_phases.label: discovery_only
promotion_phases.desc: Metadata in OpenToolsHub. No keys, no live calls, no production use.

promotion_phases.label: local_conformance
promotion_phases.desc: Local stub provider: validate API shape, response normalization, ModelInvocationReceipt.

promotion_phases.label: dev_only_live_key
promotion_phases.desc: Dev-only key, hard provider-side spend caps, no customer/private data, rate-limit aware, receipts required.

promotion_phases.label: candidate_teleon_provider
promotion_phases.desc: Usable by Teleon PurposeTasks in candidate/shadow mode. Not serving production outputs.

promotion_phases.label: approved_non_sensitive
promotion_phases.desc: Allowed for public/synthetic/non-sensitive tasks. Still not canonical for governed-context truth.

promotion_phases.label: production_with_policy
promotion_phases.desc: Requires official paid/prod terms + security + privacy review + observability + fallback + clear retention stance.
